name: GoldenEye-Recomp-Dedicated-Server
author: DaedheldirPR@github.com
description:
A tiny, standalone matchmaker and UDP relay that allows players to play the GoldenEye 007 Recompiled port together online over the internet.

One person runs this server and shares its address with the other players. Everyone enters the same address in the game's **ONLINE** menu. Players can then find and join each other's matches.

This repository contains only the server. You will need the game itself to use it. See the [GoldenEye-Recomp repository](https://github.com/SunJaycy/GoldenEye-Recomp) for more information.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

apt update
apt install -y git build-essential cmake g++

cd /mnt/server

git clone https://github.com/SunJaycy/GoldenEye-Recomp-Server.git src

cd src

g++ -O2 -std=c++17 src/server.cpp -o /mnt/server/ge_server

chmod +x /mnt/server/ge_server
